description: This file contains API client functions for interacting with a backend service in a React frontend application. It provides functions to fetch claims, fetch a specific claim by ID, update claim status, retrieve fraud signals, get explanation for claims, and upload CSV files. It also includes internal utility functions for building URLs, making requests with timeout handling, and processing responses.

methods.name: buildUrl(path)
methods.description: Constructs the full URL for API requests based on environment variables and provided path.

methods.name: safeReadJson(res)
methods.description: Reads and parses JSON from a fetch response, handling non-JSON responses by returning an object with error info.

methods.name: request(path, { method = "GET", headers, body, timeoutMs } = {})
methods.description: Performs an HTTP request with timeout and error handling, returning parsed response data.

methods.name: getClaims({ status, minScore, q } = {})
methods.description: Fetches list of claims with optional filters like status, minimum score, and query string.

methods.name: getClaimById(claimId)
methods.description: Fetches a single claim detail by claim ID.

methods.name: updateClaimStatus(claimId, status)
methods.description: Updates the status of a specific claim.

methods.name: getFraudSignals()
methods.description: Retrieves available fraud signals or rules.

methods.name: getExplanation(claimId)
methods.description: Fetches AI or rule-based explanation for a specific claim.

methods.name: uploadCsv(file)
methods.description: Uploads a CSV file to the backend for ingesting claims.

ctags.name: getClaims
ctags.pattern: /^export async function getClaims({ status, minScore, q } = {}) {$/

ctags.name: request
ctags.pattern: /^async function request(path, { method = "GET", headers, body, timeoutMs } = {}) {$/
